h1: Custom Women's Jerseys for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom women's jerseys in bulk. Perfect for teams, events, and branding. Get your quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Women’s jerseys are cut with a narrower shoulder and a slightly tapered waist, so they fit better than unisex styles right off the rack. Whether you are ordering for a company softball team, a charity 5K, or a uniform refresh, these jerseys hold up to screen printing and embroidery without shrinking or twisting. Popular choices like the Ladies’ Gildan® 5.3 oz T-Shirt and the Sport-Tek® Ladies’ Competitor™ Tee offer moisture-wicking fabric for active use. Order in bulk and get consistent sizing across all pieces.
